exposure: Treatment group (gel) vs. Control group (no treatment)
Topical gel containing Allium cepa extract, allantoin, and heparin
outcome: Scar appearance assessed using the Vancouver Scar Scale (VSS), specifically vascularity, pigmentation, and height subscales
cohort: 120 women undergoing a second elective caesarean delivery who had hypertrophic scar development after their first caesarean section.
finding: Prophylactic use of the topical gel containing onion extract significantly reduced scar vascularity, pigmentation, and height after a second caesarean section compared to no treatment.
